tools.name: qualify_b2b_lead
tools.description: Qualifies a work email or company domain with a 0-100 B2B score using live DNS MX/SPF/DMARC, RDAP domain age, 48 SaaS tech signatures, and ATS open roles.

tools.name: search_netsuite_erp_partners
tools.description: Searches the 724 verified Oracle NetSuite SuiteApp ERP software partners (ISVs), Built-for-NetSuite badges, and SuiteApp URLs.

tools.name: extract_ats_hiring_signals
tools.description: Fetches live open job count and active roles for a company slug across Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever.

tools.name: list_bulk_b2b_scrapers
tools.description: Lists pay-per-result cloud scrapers for exporting 100 to 50,000+ verified B2B leads (NetSuite ISVs, SEC Form D startups, YC batches, Shopify stores, Workday/ATS jobs).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qualify_b2b_lead, search_netsuite_erp_partners · Public sink: qualify_b2b_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qualify_b2b_lead, search_netsuite_erp_partners · Public sink: qualify_b2b_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
